guarantees.claim: On reset (negedge rst_ni), all three registers are assigned 0. On posedge clk_i, they update to the values of prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, data_out_clear_d respectively.

assumptions.claim: The combinational signals prng_reseed_d, key_clear_d, data_out_clear_d must be stable and valid at each rising edge of clk_i for correct sampling.
assumptions.cond: when rst_ni is high (out of reset)
assumptions.risk: If they glitch or violate setup/hold, metastability or incorrect clear values could be latched, possibly preventing the intended wipe of secrets.

uncertain_points.claim: The registers prng_reseed_q, key_clear_q, data_out_clear_q are named for clearing/reseeding secret material, yet they reset to 0. If the security architecture requires an immediate wipe after power-up or reset, this default may leave secrets uncleared until the _d logic explicitly asserts them.
uncertain_points.cond: after negedge rst_ni, before external clear logic activates
uncertain_points.risk: Residual key, data, or PRNG state could be exposed across a reset boundary if the clearing is delayed or never asserted by the driving logic.
